I posted the answer in #coastal-team. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on November 3, 2025.

Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2 says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap note gives the same date.

The recap also says she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21 to finish the terminal cutover, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 3 as the official date, and Nov 22 only if the tracker wants the day-to-day takeover.
